title: Birds and small animals outdoors
caption: Pigeons, sparrows, crows, gulls, island cats, butterflies and red dragonflies in the outdoor places, by time of day; flocks scatter when Eric walks up. Sparrows and wind by day, crickets after work.

sections.title: Scattering, and up close
sections.caption: Walk up to a flock and it takes off.

sections.title: Station forecourt
sections.caption: Pigeons on the paving by the head office, sparrows by the benches, crows on the roofs.

sections.title: Fountain plaza
sections.caption: Pigeons round the fountain, sparrows, a crow on the fountain top, butterflies and red dragonflies over the lawns.

sections.title: Shop street
sections.caption: Pigeons and sparrows by the planter, the ginger shop cat by a wall, a crow on a roof, gulls over the sea.

sections.title: East lane
sections.caption: Sparrows, butterflies and dragonflies over the verges.

sections.title: East coast
sections.caption: Gulls circling and sitting on the blocks, sparrows, insects over the grass.

sections.title: Gym and pool
sections.caption: Pigeons on the sports lane, dragonflies.

sections.title: Office street
sections.caption: A pigeon flock and sparrows on the street.

sections.title: Harbour
sections.caption: Gulls over the harbour, the ginger harbour cat.

sections.title: After work
sections.caption: Pigeons, sparrows and insects are gone after work; crows stay, and the cats come out.
